outline: This course aims to develop Windows applications using the C# language for students. Through the Windows Forms interface design tools of the .NET platform, students will be able to develop interactive human-computer interfaces and event-oriented applications. The course emphasizes UI design principles, event-driven architecture, and application skills, such as hardware integration in smart devices, human-machine interface (HMI), and Internet of Things applications.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Course and Windows Programming
Week 2: Variables and Expressions
Week 3: Windows Application Programming
Week 4: Basic Control
Week 5: Process Control
Week 6: Loop Structure
Week 7: Array
Week 8: Midterm Exam
Week 9: Control Array
Week 10: Comprehensive Application of Two-Dimensional Array
Week 11: Recursion
Week 12: Files Process
Week 13: Comprehensive Application of Advanced Control Items
Week 14: Mouse and Keyboard Event Handling
Week 15: Examples Practices
Week 16: Final Exam
